statement.zh: 三星堆是商王朝的殖民前哨或方国都城，已成定论。
statement.en: Sanxingdui is a settled Shang colonial outpost or fangguo capital.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: Sanxingdui–Shang political relations remain debated; registered sources do not establish a settled colonial/capital identity.
